text: Hi, Trang. Surprised to see you. What brings you here?
Oh, hello Tom. I'm looking for a knitting kit.
A knitting kit? I didn't know you like knitting.
Actually, I'm keen on many DIY activities. In my leisure time, I love knitting, building dollhouses, and making paper flowers.
I see. So, you like spending time on your own.
Yeah. What do you do in your free time?
I'm a bit different. I usually hang out with my friends. We go to the cinema, go cycling, or play sport in the park.
You love spending free time with other people, don't you?
That's right. By the way, would you like to go to the cinema with me and Mark this Sunday? There's a new comedy at New World Cinema.
Yes, I'd love to. Can I ask Mai to join us?
Sure. Let's meet outside the cinema at 9 a.m.
